annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards the transitional provisions for certain medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards the transitional provisions for certain medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal to amend the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR) and In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation (IVDR) by extending transitional periods and certificate validity for legacy devices, because notified body capacity is insufficient. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends MDR transition to 31 Dec 2027 for higher-risk devices and 31 Dec 2028 for medium and lower-risk devices
Extends validity of certificates issued under Directives 90/385/EEC and 93/42/EEC
Conditions: QMS in place, formal application by 26 May 2024, written agreement with a notified body by 26 Sept 2024
Deletes the 'sell-off' deadlines in the MDR and IVDR
Adds a transition to 26 May 2026 for class III custom-made implantable devices
